title: What changed since the record
honesty: Built and tested with throwaway keys. The owner's own key has not signed anything yet, so the record proves origin only after the owner signs. Cooperative today.
analogy: A wax seal on a letter. A broken seal tells you someone opened it, and an intact one tells you it is as it was sent.
analogy_stops: A seal says nothing about who wrote the letter. A record proves origin only once it is signed with the owner's own key, which has not happened yet.
does_not: It does not sign anything: signing is the owner's step, at the owner's own terminal.
It does not prove that a file is correct, only that it is the same bytes or the same structure.
owner_check: Run umwayi verify on a file a goal made and read the line.
Do the first real signing yourself, with your own key.

scenes.label: Ask about a file
scenes.caption: umwayi verify PATH asks whether a file was made by a umwayi task and is unchanged.

scenes.label: Same bytes
scenes.caption: The record names the file and the bytes match: unchanged, exit 0.

scenes.label: Same shape
scenes.caption: Only comments or formatting changed in a Python file: structure, and it still says so.

scenes.label: Edited since
scenes.caption: The bytes differ: changed, exit 3. A person should look before relying on it.

scenes.label: Not in the record
scenes.caption: The record does not name the file: unnamed, and there is no claim of origin.
